audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Vex, Skill, Skill while content win[N] read Brand on the first six rows and Vex on the last.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly (Brand x6, Vex late) and 50.56% over 267 games fits a lane Brand owns until her items land. The level-6 row was given to Vex even though the sentence under it described Pyroclasm coming online for Brand, and the 2+ items row was given to neither even though both the packet and the content layer hand it to Vex.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Brand, Brand, Brand, Brand, Brand, Brand, Vex on the full layer, with phases[6].why rewritten so the late row argues for Vex.

audit.why: Her level 6 is Shadow Surge, 140/120/100s, marking from 2000-3000 and recasting into a dash. The page is right that it does not threaten a lane all-in immediately and right that the matchup flips once she has items behind it.
audit.corrected: Added the 140s rank-1 cooldown to the cooldown field so the commit window is countable.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page claims Pillar of Flame out-ranges Mistral Bolt, gives Mistral Bolt an execute bonus, calls Personal Space her E and the source of the fear, and repeatedly names her passive 'Doom's Prevalence'.
audit.why: Mistral Bolt is 1200 range and accelerates mid-flight — it out-ranges Pillar of Flame (900) and even Sear (1050), and nothing in its text executes. Personal Space is W: a 475-range shield plus nearby damage, 16/15/14/13/12s. Looming Darkness (E, 800, flat 12s) is the slowing zone that applies Gloom. The fear lives on the passive, Doom 'n Gloom, which empowers her next ability to fear and interrupt dashes and recharges faster when anything dashes near her — Brand has no dash, so he never feeds that. The shield is the real burst counter: it absorbs the opening rotation, so it has to be forced out before the E-Q package goes in.
audit.corrected: Range claim reversed, the invented execute removed, every slot renamed, the passive called Doom 'n Gloom, and the shield-before-burst sequencing written in.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E/R text, ranges and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: Seventeen fields called Vex 'he/his', two Do's/Don'ts bodies were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings under unrelated titles, and breakdown.cooldowns held no digit.
audit.why: champ-gender lists vex as female; the lint located each field deterministically.

notes: Two factual reversals here. First, the page claimed Pillar of Flame out-ranges Mistral Bolt; it does not — 900 against 1200, and Sear at 1050 is still short — so the early-game advice now rests on Blaze damage rather than a range advantage that does not exist. Second, Mistral Bolt has no execute component in Riot's text and that clause was removed rather than reworded. 'Doom's Prevalence' is not an ability in this kit; the passive is Doom 'n Gloom and it is where the fear lives, not Personal Space (W), which is a shield. suspectNames flagged 'Your Pillar of Flame' in spikes[0] as a name error: the name was fine, the claim around it was not. Full-layer sides disagreed with the content layer on all seven rows; the last row is now Vex on both layers, matching packet.levelChart, and phases[6].why was rewritten so it argues for her. Ratings left untouched — the rating tracks stage intensity rather than ownership in this data.
